questions.q: What is IT Service Management (ITSM), most accurately?
options: The discipline of planning, delivering, supporting, and improving IT services as a managed practice
A specific ticketing tool used by help desks
Another name for the IT help desk team
A certification exam about server hardware
questions.explain: ITSM is the management discipline itself — the help desk and any ticketing tool are implementations of it, not ITSM itself.

questions.q: In a purely reactive IT support model, what typically happens when the one person who knows how to fix a recurring issue leaves the company?
options: Nothing changes, because the fix was documented
The organization is exposed, because the knowledge was never captured outside that person
The issue automatically stops recurring
A service owner immediately takes over with no disruption
questions.explain: Reactive, tribal-knowledge support scales only as far as institutional memory — losing the one person who knows the fix leaves a real gap.

questions.q: According to ITIL 4's definition, what makes something a "service" rather than just "technology"?
options: It runs on dedicated hardware instead of shared infrastructure
It has a formal name in the IT department's org chart
It enables value co-creation by facilitating an outcome the customer wants, without the customer managing specific costs and risks
It appears in the vendor's product catalog
questions.explain: The ITIL 4 definition is about the outcome delivered and the costs/risks taken off the customer's plate — not about the underlying technology itself.

questions.q: Which pair below correctly distinguishes "the technology" from "the service," per this lesson's email example?
options: The email server is the service; corporate email with support and a security policy is the technology
The email server is the technology; the corporate email service (with availability targets, support, onboarding, security) is the service
There is no meaningful distinction between the two
Both terms refer only to the physical hardware
questions.explain: The server itself is the technology; everything wrapped around it that delivers value without the user managing cost or risk is the service.

questions.q: How does this lesson describe the relationship between ITSM and ITIL?
options: ITIL and ITSM are two unrelated certifications
ITSM is a feature included only in ITIL 4
ITSM is the broad management discipline; ITIL is the most widely adopted framework for practicing it
ITIL replaced the need for ITSM entirely
questions.explain: ITSM is the discipline; ITIL is a specific, widely adopted published framework organizations use to put that discipline into practice.
